name: Morley
source:
A hermit Caprese encounters in the forest. His Arcana is the Hermit.
[spoiler]
He is actually the elder brother of  the Hierophant Hymnus, and father of Analiese, who abandoned the succession in favour of his younger brother. He saved the infant Caprese and his twin.
[/spoiler]
